title: Lacatski says the reverse engineering was semi-successful

tellings.quote: our own programs that have been successful to some extent per James Latsky saying yeah we were semisuccessful

plain: A former US intelligence worker named Dylan Borland, speaking on a podcast, says that James Lacatski, a defence intelligence official who ran a government-funded UFO study, told people the US had been partly successful at reverse engineering, meaning taking apart unknown craft to learn how to build them. Borland quotes Lacatski as saying, in effect, "yeah, we were semi-successful." If true, it would mean American programmes have already learned something real from non-human technology.
